1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.Bd2 dxe4 5.Q.strategy: Takes the pawn and attacks the h8 rook in the same move. The queen is far from the rest of White's pieces, though, and Black's reply gains time to harass it, so White has to watch Black's lead in development.
Saves the rook with tempo by attacking the queen, and the rook takes the open g-file, pointing at g2. Black has traded the g7 pawn for activity and development.
